medications.dose: 500 mg PO once daily with evening meal, titrate by 500 mg weekly to 500 mg twice daily, then up to 1 g twice daily as tolerated (max 2 g/day)
medications.purpose: First‑line glucose‑lowering therapy for T2DM; improves HbA1c and reduces cardiovascular risk
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG28 recommends Metformin MR as first‑line for all adults with T2DM (2024 update).

medications.purpose: Add‑on glucose‑lowering agent; provides cardiovascular and renal protection in T2DM and early CKD
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG28 advises SGLT2‑i alongside Metformin from the start for T2DM (2024 update). Also recommended in CKD (NG203).

medications.dose: 40 mg PO once daily in the evening
medications.duration: Lifelong – lipid profile at 4‑6 weeks, then annually
medications.purpose: Reduce LDL‑C and total cholesterol; lowers cardiovascular risk in FH suspicion and diabetes
medications.nice_justification: NICE CG181 recommends high‑intensity statin for adults ≥40 y with LDL‑C >100 mg/dL or QRISK ≥10% (or FH).

contraindications.reason: If eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m² there is a risk of lactic acidosis (NICE NG28, NG203).
contraindications.alternative: Use reduced dose (≤1 g/day) if eGFR 30‑45, or omit Metformin and continue Empagliflozin alone.

contraindications.reason: Avoid in patients with recurrent genital/urinary infections or history of ketoacidosis (NICE NG28).
contraindications.alternative: Consider DPP‑4 inhibitor (e.g., Sitagliptin) if risk is high.

assumptions_warnings: eGFR not provided – assumed ≥60 mL/min/1.73 m² for initial prescribing; will obtain serum creatinine/eGFR before starting Metformin and Empagliflozin.
Urine albumin‑creatinine ratio (ACR) not available – ACE‑I (Ramipril) will be considered only if ACR ≥30 mg/mmol or hypertension is confirmed.
Liver function tests not provided – baseline LFTs required before initiating Atorvastatin.
Allergy status unknown – will screen for statin or Metformin hypersensitivity.
Pregnancy status not documented – patient uses medroxyprogesterone acetate injection for contraception; confirm effective contraception before SGLT2‑i.
treatment_summary: Start Metformin MR 500 mg daily and titrate to target dose, add Empagliflozin 10 mg daily, and initiate Atorvastatin 40 mg nightly to achieve glycaemic control and lower LDL‑C. Monitor renal function, liver enzymes, lipid profile, and HbA1c as per NICE NG28/NG203/CG181. Provide lifestyle advice, physiotherapy for chronic pain, and arrange baseline investigations (eGFR, ACR, LFTs, iron studies) before finalising therapy.
